correctness.rationale: For M_n=(D^1,S^0)^{C_n} with C_3=boundary triangle, cells count V=2^n, E=n2^{n-1}, squares=n2^{n-2}; every vertex link is C_n, making a closed connected orientable surface of chi=(4-n)2^{n-2}. Coordinate sign flip on S has fixed points iff every flipped coordinate can be interior simultaneously, i.e. S is a vertex (2^{n-3} fixed circles) or an adjacent pair (2^{n-2} isolated fixed points); all other actions free. Its orientation degree is (-1)^|S|, and local fixed-point actions are respectively a boundary reflection and orientation-preserving half-turn branch. The formula chi(quotient)=(chi(M)+chi(Fix))/2, connectedness of quotients, and the compact surface classification give the four stated genus/crosscap formulas and equal nonfree genus. Direct integer Euler/genus identities verified for n=3..12. The inspected sign-equivariant subdivision program enumerates all 243 nontrivial sign involutions n=3..7; this finite check supplements rather than proves the general cell/fixed-locus argument. Boundary examples n=3 give disk/S2/RP2 and n=4 give annulus/S2/T2/Klein bottle.
